channel.title: Odd County Files

item.title: EP001: The Loneliest Phone Booth in the Mojave Desert
item.description: A single payphone, miles from anywhere, in the middle of the Mojave Desert. In 1997 the internet discovered it. People drove across the country just to answer it.
item.itunes:summary: A single payphone, miles from anywhere, in the middle of the Mojave Desert. In 1997 the internet discovered it. People drove across the country just to answer it.

item.title: EP002: Lawn Chair Larry
item.description: In 1982, a California man bought 45 weather balloons, strapped them to a lawn chair, and flew to 16,000 feet. The FAA was not amused.
item.itunes:summary: In 1982, a California man bought 45 weather balloons, strapped them to a lawn chair, and flew to 16,000 feet. The FAA was not amused.

item.title: EP003: The Girl Who Fell from the Sky
item.description: 17-year-old Juliane Koepcke fell 18,000 feet into the Amazon rainforest after her plane broke apart mid-air. She survived alone for 11 days.
item.itunes:summary: 17-year-old Juliane Koepcke fell 18,000 feet into the Amazon rainforest after her plane broke apart mid-air. She survived alone for 11 days.

item.title: EP004: The Island That Sank Twice — Bermeja
item.description: An island appeared on maps for 400 years. Then in 1997 it vanished. Billions in oil rights depended on whether it existed or not.
item.itunes:summary: An island appeared on maps for 400 years. Then in 1997 it vanished. Billions in oil rights depended on whether it existed or not.

item.title: EP005: The Ghosts of Stanley Hotel
item.description: In 1974, Stephen King stayed at an almost empty hotel in Colorado. He had a nightmare. He wrote The Shining. But the ghosts were already there.
